phase_prompt.summary: Final blazing sky with glowing glyphs and crystalline lattice.
phase_prompt.prompt_block: A cinematic, photorealistic sky ablaze with molten orange and crimson flames, where ancient Ethiopian and Egyptian glyphs burn across cloud formations, crystalline lattices refract the fire into prismatic shards, and bio‑luminescent vines weave through the horizon, all rendered with tactile detail, grounded realism, and industrial mysticism, evoking a sense of incomprehensible ancient technology.
